userStories.title: W2·S3 — Inline Composio connect card in chat
userStories.description: Reuse the EXISTING Composio OAuth flow — do not build a second one. Grounding (2026-08-27): the OAuth callback page is frontend/app/tools/callback/page.tsx; the initiation endpoint was not pinned at kit time — RE-VERIFY by grep (candidates: api/composio*.py, the integrations/tools settings surface that today's Tools page uses to connect apps) and reuse whatever route the existing Tools connect button calls. New frontend/components/onboarding/connect-app-card.tsx rendered in chat (follow the wave-1b chat-card pattern from power-up-card/intake-progress-card): names the app Auto asked for, opens the existing OAuth popup, reflects the callback result back into the conversation (the callback page already lands the result — bridge it to chat state via the same mechanism the Tools page uses, or a focused refetch on window focus; do NOT invent a new event bus). Emit 'first integration connected' as a first-class funnel event (follow the trial_* funnel event pattern from US-004/005) exactly once per workspace — detected from the workspace's connection count transitioning 0→1, not from the popup closing.

userStories.title: W2·S4 — Post-setup checklist card (chat + Command Center)
userStories.description: Checklist state lives INSIDE workspaces.onboarding.checklist (JSONB — NO migration; extend onboarding_state.py with a checklist read/update entrypoint that follows the same full-reassignment write style as reset_onboarding/_write_trial). Items (per PRD): connect a second app · invite a teammate (ONLY rendered when the workspace plan has >1 seat — read the existing plan/plan_limits surface) · run your first mission · take the matched Academy course (map the stored segment.comfort to a static academy URL — novice→ABF, technical→APA; a simple mapping constant, no new service). Completion detection from REAL events where the platform already records them: second app = connections count ≥2; first mission = missions count ≥1; teammate = members count ≥2; the Academy item is the one manual-dismiss exception (no cross-repo tracking exists — render its check on dismiss and say so in a code comment). Frontend: frontend/components/onboarding/setup-checklist-card.tsx rendered in chat AND on the Command Center (follow trial-balance-pill's dual-surface pattern from wave 1b); dismissible; dismissal persisted in the checklist doc (server-side, NOT localStorage — D8).
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist read/update entrypoint in onboarding_state.py using full-JSONB-reassignment writes; state under workspaces.onboarding.checklist; zero new migrations from this story
Item completion derived from real counts (connections/missions/members) — backend tests prove each detection; invite item absent for single-seat plans (test)
setup-checklist-card.tsx renders on chat + Command Center, dismissible, dismissal server-persisted (component tests; grep proves no localStorage use)

userStories.description: The PRD §10 inventory, anchors re-verified 2026-08-27. (3) Wizard UI: delete frontend/app/onboarding/wizard/**, frontend/components/wizard/**, frontend/hooks/use-wizard-api.ts (and the now-relocated use-wizard-progress.ts original); BACKEND intake pipeline + api/wizard.py endpoints STAY (tool substrate). Keep handlers_missions.py's source field itself (only the mission_zero consumption dies). (5) Admin surface: delete frontend/components/settings/OnboardingAgentsTab.tsx + its SystemSettingsTab.tsx mount, orchestrator/api/onboarding_agents.py + its main.py import/mount + router_manifest.py entry + committed route-manifest rows (hand-edit + count bump DOWN — never regenerate). (6) THE ONE MIGRATION of this wave: deactivate/remove the seeded required_role='onboarding' system agents from live DBs — idempotent, guarded (no-op when rows absent), and it must NOT touch agents created by any other path. (7) Org-chart empty state (frontend/components/agents/org-chart-tab.tsx): re-point 'Mission Zero' copy to asking Auto. (8) Update or delete superseded tests (tests/api/test_onboarding_journey.py and any wizard/shepherd component tests) — deleting a dead surface's tests WITH the surface is correct here, not a coverage loss.
